posts.text:
Don told me about getting arrested while reporting, and what stuck with me most was this:

“If I become scared, what use am I to the people who need me not to be?”

Full conversation is up now on my YouTube.

One of the most interesting parts of this conversation with Don was hearing how he thinks about truth in media.

Not left. Not right. Just true.

Sounds simple. Apparently it’s not.

Full episode is up on my YouTube.
